title: Push both feature branches and open a draft PR
detail: feature/murmur-app-remediation pushed (HEAD a50565d); draft PR https://github.com/bido75/murmur/pull/15 with green CI. feature/transcription-local remains unpushed — separate authorized operation. Not merged.

title: Rotate exposed credential sets (now 19)
detail: Checklist docs/post-audit/05-CREDENTIAL-ROTATION-CHECKLIST.md. Rows 17–19 added 2026-10-29: Cloudflare Global API key, scoped API + tunnel tokens, SMTP mailbox password (info@giscop.com). Any active compromised credential is a release blocker.

title: Public HTTPS origin + provider-console registration
detail: Origin LIVE: https://notes.giscop.com serves app + API + OAuth on one origin (verified). Google console: URIs registered by the operator (confirmed by the console listing 2026-10-29). REMAINING: Slack app console and Procore developer portal registration. Exact URIs in docs/post-audit/06.

title: One live OAuth round-trip per provider
detail: Everything up to the consent screen is verified live: OTP sign-in through the domain, calendar/start returning a real accounts.google.com consent URL, callbacks no longer gated (valid state consumed + 302), Claude DCR verified. What remains is a human clicking Connect -> consent -> back per provider. Nothing fabricated.

title: Webhook delivery retry queue with backoff
detail: Only last delivery status is recorded; a retry queue (webhook_deliveries + scheduled retry) remains backlog.

title: Telephony provider decision (RingCentral vs Aircall/Twilio)
detail: Repo targets RingCentral; provided creds are Aircall/Twilio-shaped.

title: OAuth-client registry vs token-paste for trackers
detail: Notion/Atlassian/Asana/Linear/monday/ClickUp/Trello secrets have no server home in the token-paste model.

title: Physical-device test matrix (recording, recovery, a11y, onboarding walkthrough)
detail: Matrix in docs/post-audit/09; expected outcomes for recovery scenarios in docs/release-verification/05; onboarding walkthrough lines added to the README device checklist.

title: macOS/Linux desktop runs
detail: Desktop suite green on Windows (electron 44.10.0); non-Windows runs remain.

title: Murmure AGPL boundary legal sign-off
detail: Clean-room reasoning in docs/LICENSE_REVIEW.md; no AGPL-derived code introduced.

title: Long-recording and scale performance measurements
detail: Server pipeline measured at 15/30/60 min (611s for 60 min); two production defects found and fixed (unbounded notes prompt, stuck transient states). Client-side memory/battery and large-collection UI remain hardware-bound. Evidence: docs/release-verification/10.

title: GitHub CI run evidence
detail: Run 40829899080 success (all five jobs) at a50565d: https://github.com/bido75/murmur/actions/runs/40829899080. CI also caught and confirmed two real regressions along the way (secret-scan portability, lockfile desync) — the gate works.
